H01.bug: Uses OR instead of AND when applying the mask to change pulses, causing enabled mask bits to appear as changes.

H02.bug: Drives the word-change pulse from masked data rather than from detected changes.

H03.bug: Compares masked input against the unmasked latched pattern, so masked-off pattern bits can prevent a match.

H04.bug: Retains the latched pattern while disabled instead of clearing it.

H05.bug: Applies the current mask when capturing the pattern, rather than storing the supplied pattern unchanged.

H06.bug: Pattern matching detects inequality, causing the match pulse to assert when the masked input does not match the latched pattern.

H07.bug: Uses a reduction AND to aggregate bit-change pulses, so the word-change pulse asserts only when every bit changes simultaneously.

H08.bug: Compares against the live match pattern instead of the latched pattern.

H09.bug: Uses XOR reduction for the word-change pulse, so simultaneous changes on an even number of bits cancel out.

H10.bug: Inverts the sampled input history, making the change detector report the wrong transitions.

code_coverage.policy: Icarus executed assignment lines and branch arms; probed and original outputs agree
